_read_me: Guardrail #1 (ENGINEERING_GUARDRAILS.md): checked-in expected RLS policy
shape for tables where a live drift has already caused, or could cause,
the RK-0 class of bug (a policy named for one role but scoped to
another). checkPolicyManifest.ts diffs this against the live database
(via list_rls_policy_manifest(), 2026-09-04_policy_manifest_rpc.sql) in CI.
PARTIAL COVERAGE BY DESIGN, not by oversight: only tables listed under
"tables" below are diffed exactly (extra/missing/mismatched policy on a
LISTED table fails the build). A table NOT listed here is reported as
"unpinned" (visible in CI output) but does not fail the build — this is
an honest incremental-coverage design, not a claim that every table is
covered. Do not treat an empty diff as "the whole schema is clean";
check the unpinned-table count in the run output too.
Every entry below was seeded from a live, human-run `pg_policies` query
or from a decisions-log-recorded live confirmation this session (D-8,
RK-0) — never guessed or reconstructed from migration-file intent alone
(that would just re-commit the exact migration-drift error this
guardrail exists to catch). Extend this file the same way: run
`select schemaname, tablename, policyname, roles, cmd, qual, with_check
from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' order by tablename` for real
and paste the actual result in, one table at a time.
roles is the exact `roles` array pg_policies returns — order matters for
the diff (Postgres returns it in a stable order per policy, not
re-sorted here).

ranked_games._source: RK-0 fix, confirmed applied live 2026-09-04 (HARDENING_PLAN.md decisions log, row RK-0). Human dropped and recreated this policy scoped to service_role after finding it was `to public`.

policies.policyname: Service role can insert ranked games

rating_periods._source: RK-0 fix, confirmed applied live 2026-09-04 (HARDENING_PLAN.md decisions log, row RK-0). Same fix as ranked_games.

policies.policyname: Service role can insert rating periods

room_live_sessions._source: D-8 (HARDENING_PLAN.md decisions log) — human ran `select policyname, cmd, roles, qual, with_check from pg_policies where tablename in ('room_live_sessions','room_match_logs')` on 2026-09-01 and confirmed the exact rows below live. No SELECT policy exists on this table at all — that absence is itself load-bearing (deny-by-default for reads), not an omission from this manifest.

room_match_logs._source: D-8 (HARDENING_PLAN.md decisions log), same 2026-09-01 confirmation as room_live_sessions.
